card.name: Word just before a noun like dignity or dose
card.fires_on: A modifier or partial word right before an expected noun, such as 'personal' before dignity, 'evening' before meals, or 'Andro-gen' before receptor. It appears in Catechism-style text and in drug-label dosing or interaction text.

modes.label: Catechism phrases
modes.description: Adjectives or determiners before a noun about persons or faith, such as personal, human, other, its.

modes.description: Meal-time or drug-name words right before a noun like meals, dose, or receptor.

card.writes: It pushes toward words like free, freedom and dimension, and away from therapy words, so it hints that a noun other than therapy comes next.
card.plain: It fires on a word that sets up the next noun, such as personal dignity or evening meals, in religious or drug-label text.
